context: A dad reads a bedtime story to his young son
purpose: Teach: 望み/すこし/かぎり/幼い/ボケ/ゆとり/せいぜい/独り言

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 今夜は幼い王子さまの物語だよ。すこしだけ長いけど、最後まで聞けるかな?
lines.en: Tonight it's the story of the young prince. It's a bit long, but can you listen to the end?
lines.style: Warm, gentle bedtime voice, slow and soothing pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん!ぼく、ねむくなるかぎり、ずっと聞いてるよ。
lines.en: Yeah! I'll keep listening as long as I don't get sleepy.
lines.style: Excited child voice, eager but already a little drowsy.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: よし。むかしむかし、小さなお城に、ひとつの望みを抱えた王子さまがいました。
lines.en: Okay. Long ago, in a small castle, there lived a prince who held one wish.
lines.style: Storyteller cadence, hushed and rhythmic, drawing the child in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ねえパパ、王子さまって、せいぜい何さいくらい?
lines.en: Hey Dad, the prince — how old is he, at most?
lines.style: Curious interruption, bright and a little goofy in tone.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うーん、たぶん翔とおなじくらいかな。心にゆとりのある、やさしい子だったんだ。
lines.en: Hmm, probably about the same age as you, Sho. He was a kind boy with a peaceful heart.
lines.style: Affectionate, smiling delivery, personalizing the tale.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ふふ、パパのものまね、ちょっとボケてて変だよ〜。
lines.en: Hehe, Dad, your impression is a little goofy and weird!
lines.style: Giggly teasing, playful and light, with a sleepy edge.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: (独り言みたいに)…そうか、パパの声、変だったか…まあいい、続けるぞ。
lines.en: (almost muttering to himself) ...I see, my voice was weird, huh... well, never mind, I'll continue.
lines.style: Soft, half-muttered aside, mock-wounded humor, distinct timbre that anchors the scene

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: パパ、王子さまの望み、なんだったの?
lines.en: Dad, what was the prince's wish?
lines.style: Drowsy but curious, voice softening toward sleep.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: それはね…あしたのお楽しみ。おやすみ、翔。いい夢を。
lines.en: That... is a surprise for tomorrow. Goodnight, Sho. Sweet dreams.
lines.style: Whisper-soft closing, tender and tucked-in warm.
